messages.content:
In two or three sentences, explain why a household AI lab might choose to
run a large language model locally on its own hardware instead of only
using a hosted API, even though the hosted API is usually cheaper per
token.

message.content: A household AI lab may run a model locally to keep sensitive data on its own hardware, reducing privacy and compliance risks. Local inference can also provide lower latency, offline operation, and more control over customization or fine-tuning. At high usage volumes, owning hardware can become more cost-effective than paying per-token API fees.
